case_title: Satya Raj Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh
neutral_facts: The incident occurred on 19.09.1999 around 7 p.m. in village Imaliya. Four individuals, including the deceased, were sitting on a platform. The appellant and another accused approached the group, leading to an altercation. The appellant assaulted the deceased on his neck and nearby area with a knife. Witnesses saw the assault and chased the appellant and the other accused. The deceased was taken to a nearby house and later died. An FIR was lodged the next day, and the case was investigated. The prosecution presented multiple witnesses, including eyewitnesses and a medical report confirming the injuries. The trial court convicted the appellant for murder, and the High Court upheld the conviction.
